Your Campus Marketplace

Buy, sell, and exchange books and notes within your campus community.
Discover affordable resources, clear your shelves, and connect with fellow students in a fast, secure marketplace.

Why Students Love Campus Market?

  • 🎓 Student Verification

    Every user must register using a valid student ID to keep the marketplace safe and trusted.

  • 🔐 OTP Delivery Confirmation

    Payment is released only after you confirm delivery via OTP.

  • 💳 Secure Payment System

    Campus Market supports secure payments through bKash and Nagad.

  • 📍 Campus-Based Trading

    Save time and transportation cost by trading within campus.

  • ⭐ Ratings and Reviews

    Students can rate sellers and leave reviews to help others make trusted buying decisions.

  • 📍 Campus Community

    Opportunity to build a strong communication and connection through this platform .

  • ♻️ Reuse and Recycle

    Give used items a second life and reduce waste.

How It Works

  1. Register

    Buyers and sellers register using their Student ID for verification.

  2. Browse Products

    Buyers browse products by category or search using keywords.

  3. Place Order & Pay

    Buyers place an order and complete secure payment using bKash or Nagad.

  4. Platform Holds Payment

    The payment is securely held by Campus Market until delivery is confirmed.

  5. Seller Delivers Product

    The seller delivers the product and requests an OTP through the platform.

  6. Buyer Receives OTP

    The buyer receives an OTP from the platform and shares it with the seller after receiving the product.

  7. OTP Verification

    The seller submits the OTP through the platform to confirm successful delivery.

  8. Seller Gets Payment

    After OTP verification, the platform releases the payment to the seller.

  9. Ratings & Reviews

    The buyer can leave ratings and reviews to help maintain a trusted student marketplace.
